column3: A single MapLibre map can mix **any number of sources** (`raster`, `vector`, `geojson`, `image`, …) and layer them in any order.

column2: No 3-D terrain, hillshading, or high-DPI text rendering.
column3: Built-in terrain (`raster-dem`) and crisp SDF text.

4. **Add a `vector` source** that points at the new vector-tile endpoint you will serve (e.g. `https://mytiles.example.com/{z}/{x}/{y}.pbf`).
